issues.issue: Whether the claimant rebutted the presumption that El Salvador and Guatemala can protect her from her husband.
issues.applicant_position: Husband abused her for years; one police report did not secure protection, so state protection is inadequate.
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to rebut presumption of state protection with clear and convincing evidence.

issues.issue: Whether an internal flight alternative exists in Quezaltenango, Guatemala.
issues.applicant_position: Husband may find her in Guatemala through his contacts and bribes; relocation is not safe.
issues.result_text: Viable IFA exists in Quezaltenango; relocation would not be unduly harsh for the claimant.
